job.title: Développeur Senior Salesforce Commerce Cloud - F/H

tailoring.headline: Senior Developer & E-Commerce Consultant | Enterprise Platforms & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, production troubleshooting, and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Développeur Senior Salesforce Commerce Cloud - F/H
cover_en.hook: Niji's unique combination of digital expertise, cutting-edge AI integration, and delivery of innovative solutions for enterprise clients makes this role exceptionally compelling. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building, extending, and integrating large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical depth in e-commerce architectures, RESTful APIs, and complex backend-to-frontend integrations.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Architecture & Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and frontend functionality on enterprise commerce platforms using Java and Spring, ensuring high performance, responsive data flows, and adherence to best practices.

bullets.label: API Integration & Services
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, customizing interceptors, populators, and converters to integrate third-party services and maintain seamless customer data flows.

bullets.label: Performance & Maintenance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring, resolved integration bottlenecks across ERP and MDM platforms, and ensured continuous platform performance, stability, and code quality through rigorous reviews and testing.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and international technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, bridging business needs and IT execution.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15.12.2026 and an earliest start date of 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise e-commerce and integration expertise can contribute to Niji's client projects.

tailoring.why_company: Niji stands out through its unique integration of digital expertise, consulting, design, and AI to deliver concrete, innovative solutions for major accounts and intermediate-sized enterprises. I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering, API development, and techno-functional analysis to Niji's multidisciplinary teams, driving high-performance digital solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform development, API integration, and techno-functional consulting experience to Niji's innovative digital projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce development, API integration, and techno-functional experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in Niji's senior tech roles. I hold a valid work permit in Germany and can start Dec 16, 2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Développeur Senior Salesforce Commerce Cloud - F/H - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Développeur Senior Salesforce Commerce Cloud position at Niji.

With over 5 years of professional experience engineering enterprise e-commerce platforms, RESTful APIs, and complex data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise and a strong techno-functional background.

Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am available to start on December 16, 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
